scope: The surviving Valerian Palace ruins at Bishapur, limited to the photographed ashlared walls and nearby low masonry traces inside the mapped enclosure.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Iranian-Italian field survey describes distinct archaeological areas around the site known as Valerian’s Prison and nearby passages, rocky slopes and walls. The attribution is traditional.
